chapter: Baton Rouge big band and New York
title: Livery Stable Blues, the rooster clarinet effect, and vaudeville in New York
summary: He explains who played the rooster part, says they went into vaudeville rather than record in New York, and demonstrates the rooster crow.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
